prompt: Write two TypeScript React files for a Sui dApp. First, a dapp-kit.ts config file that imports createDAppKit from '@mysten/dapp-kit-react' and SuiGrpcClient from '@mysten/sui/grpc', creates a dAppKit instance with testnet network config. Second, an App.tsx that imports DAppKitProvider from '@mysten/dapp-kit-react' and ConnectButton from '@mysten/dapp-kit-react/ui', wraps the app in DAppKitProvider passing the dAppKit instance.

Write a TypeScript React component called WalletStatus that uses useCurrentAccount, useCurrentWallet, and useCurrentNetwork hooks from '@mysten/dapp-kit-react'. Display the wallet name, address, and network when connected. Show a connect prompt when no account is available.
